label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, including chair, chief, president, director, executive or head.
scope_notes: Preserves prior office scope. Founder, owner, ordinary employee or athletic lead alone is insufficient; an explicit qualifying office in any supplied row supports the fact, with other meanings flagged.

facts.reason: Martins is explicitly director and co-director of City Ballet.
Arafat is explicitly PLO leader, chairman and head.
Robertson is explicitly Christian Coalition head, president and leader; founding alone would not establish office.
McIlvaine is explicitly Mets manager and president in current/past office constructions.
Mr. Lee is explicitly Taiwan president and leads it; citizenship and travel are different predicates.
